title.narrative: Provision of lifesaving WASH services and needs to the most vulnerable cholera-affected populations of Oromia and Somali

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to provide health and water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) assistance to vulnerable communities affected by a cholera outbreak. This UNICEF project provides fresh water to vulnerable households, and prevents cholera spreading. The project provides humanitarian assistance to 205,835 people, including 39,109 women, 37,050 men, 129,676 children, and including 35,815 persons with disabilities.
